title: Noble Carbon will show how it’s making EV charger installs painless at TechCrunch Disrupt | TechCrunch
summary: Electrical panels in people’s homes are typically designed to handle absolute peak usage, something that might happen only “a handful of hours per year,” Spencer Fields, Noble Carbon’s head of marketing, told TechCrunch.
